headline: OpenAI rolls out GPT-6 with interactive UI to all ChatGPT users
summary: ChatGPT can now generate interactive elements like buttons and charts in its responses, making complex information easier to understand and interact with.
details: OpenAI has begun rolling out GPT-6 to all ChatGPT users, introducing a new capability called Intelligent UI. This feature allows the AI to generate fully interactive user interfaces within its responses, going beyond simple text.

The enhanced model is trained to handle everyday conversations more effectively and can compose more visual responses. Depending on the query, ChatGPT might now include graphics, tappable buttons, forms, and charts, offering a richer user experience.

For instance, asking for help planning a dinner could result in an interactive table of ingredients to buy, complete with checklists and follow-up forms for more detailed assistance. If pure text is more appropriate, the model will opt for that instead.

To improve response times for complex tasks, GPT-6 can now answer while it's still processing, unlike models that wait until completion. OpenAI also trained it to build responses across multiple messages, ensuring a cohesive final output.

These interactive responses aim to simplify understanding of complex topics through visual aids. Users can also leverage this to create custom tools, such as an investment calculator or a bill-splitting assistant, and even recreate retro games like Snake within ChatGPT.

GPT-6 with Intelligent UI is already available for ChatGPT Plus, Pro, Business, and Enterprise users, powered by GPT-6 Sol. Free and Go account users will receive access later today, powered by the less capable GPT-6 Luna.
